provenance.matching: Exact case_uid; verified frozen ordered clause IDs, injection identity, planned/actual case identity, source hashes and main_case_order. Retain all 80 cases including strict failures.
provenance.extra_metrics: Root@1/MRR and endpoint/evidence recall are deterministic offline calculations from the same historical ranking/H and frozen labels. Failed cases have zero hit/recall metrics and null output size/compression. No current-run SA is used.
provenance.budget_field: rows[].usage.total_tokens, directly from historical llm_usage_summary.total_tokens, including consumed tokens for strict failures.
provenance.compression_definition: Arithmetic mean over valid cases of 1 - output_n/source_n; invalid cases have null compression.
